title: Apartment Interior Design 160 m² in Dubai | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 160 m² apartment in Dubai: design project, 3D visualisation, custom furniture and turnkey renovation. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Premium apartment interior design project, Dubai, UAE, 160 m²

blocks.text: Premium apartment interior design project, Dubai, UAE, 160 m²

parts.html: In this project, the interior design studio DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) completed a full-scope premium interior design project in Dubai, UAE, including concept development, custom furniture production, and turnkey renovation.

The design covered all areas of the 160 m² apartment in Dubai: living room, bedrooms, kitchen with custom storage and built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entryway, bathrooms, cabinets, and shelving.
Bespoke furniture was created for each zone, tailored to the client’s requests, lifestyle, and the architecture of the space.

Before the work began, the client received a detailed cost estimate covering all stages of the project, including construction and finishing works, custom furniture, appliances, plumbing, lighting, and other elements.
The project is presented with photorealistic 3D visualizations, providing a detailed view of the planned interior and its design solutions.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN successfully implements projects in Slovakia, across Europe, and internationally, including Dubai and other destinations in the Middle East. We offer a full cycle of interior design services, from concept development and custom furniture to renovation and complete interior realization.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN — interiors that come to life.
